sampling_disclosure.note: One sample does not establish a cause for 47. Stating the sample size is the difference between a demonstrated mechanism and an assumed one.

what_run_D_actually_supports.supported: Within the scanned scope, no source, test, or configuration file has an mtime later than 2026-08-31 17:00. The scan returned exactly three paths: QWEN_BRAIN_VNEXT_VLA_INTEGRATION_SPEC.md (a documentation file) and two .pytest_cache entries.
what_run_D_actually_supports.NOT_supported_1_mtime_is_not_a_digest: find -newermt compares modification times, not content. A file could be rewritten with identical bytes, or modified and its mtime restored. Byte identity would require digests taken before and after; no digest of the 2026-08-31 repository state exists.
what_run_D_actually_supports.NOT_supported_2_excluded_trees: The scan excludes .git, __pycache__, .venv and artifacts. It says nothing about those trees.
what_run_D_actually_supports.NOT_supported_3_the_scan_is_not_empty: run D returned three paths, so it is not an empty result. But a NEWER MTIME DOES NOT PROVE A BYTE CHANGE — touch alters mtime without altering content. The correct predicate is that 'not a single byte changed' is UNSUPPORTED by this evidence, not that it is CONTRADICTED by it. An earlier draft of this very field said 'contradicted', which claimed our own evidence refuted the sentence when it merely fails to support it. Same defect class as everything else in this record: a predicate stronger than what the artifact carries — this time in the negative direction.
